name: Frictions – Checkout Session Replay for WooCommerce
author: Plugins.shop

sections.description:
See what happened at checkout. Frictions is a WooCommerce checkout session replay plugin for reviewing eligible visits inside WordPress. Watch protected checkout recordings, find observed errors and inspect the steps around them.

Supports Classic checkout and Checkout Blocks. No Frictions account, paid recording allowance or trial deadline.

Find the steps worth investigating

Review validation errors, field interactions and steps before a visit ended or a linked order was placed. Compare mobile/desktop visits. No observed order is not proof of abandonment.

Included in Free

  • Protected visual replay: recorded page layout, supported styling, visible page text, selections, local images and fonts. Text-field masking is On by default.
  • Find recordings: replay-reference search, sorting, quick date ranges and visible filters for device, browser, checkout layout, outcome, issue, duration and watch status.
  • Review tools: bookmarks, watched state, page selection, bulk review actions and explanations of incomplete recordings.
  • Local order shortcuts where a valid association exists.
  • Setup and diagnostics, including a real-recording check and the latest receipt among retained shopper recordings.
  • Controls: pause, delete, retention and storage budget.

New recordings preserve the checkout page’s supported visual appearance, including layout, colors, typography and approved local logo/product images. Visible page text, selected labels and checkbox/radio states remain visible in either masking mode. Text-field masking defaults On; owners can turn it Off to include ordinary typed values. Page text and selections may already contain personal information, even with text-field masking On. Payment regions, passwords, security fields and explicitly private regions stay protected in either mode; payment-like card and IBAN text is omitted. Replay is inert and makes no external asset requests. Visual capture requires CSS Typed OM computed sizing; other browsers use a labelled structural fallback. Unsupported assets, SVG/canvas, shadow DOM and some CSS effects may not reproduce; this is not pixel-perfect video. Older recordings remain structural because their original appearance was never captured.

Set up recording your way

Local image copies require PHP GD; without it, image regions stay masked while supported layout and local fonts remain available.

Recording starts disabled. Choose a mode and use Save and start recording; no separate consent plugin is required for the built-in choices:

  • Built-in prompt: visitors allow or decline; no other banner plugin needed.
  • Consent integration: supported CookieYes, Cookiebot or custom bridge.
  • Owner-controlled: explicitly acknowledged recording without asking first, with visitor opt-out.

Built-in controls cover Frictions only. Consent modes require affirmative permission. Owner-controlled is not visitor consent or a compliance exemption. Refusal, opt-out, GPC and Do Not Track stop capture in every mode. Existing settings are preserved.

Recording privacy is an optional inline link, off by default. Enable it in Settings or place [frictions_privacy_link] manually. Hiding it never grants consent: the built-in prompt still appears when needed. Owner-controlled panels never open automatically. Consent integrations keep their own controls.

Free and optional Pro

Separate Pro adds guided review, saved views, notes, developer briefs and opt-in WordPress-mail notifications. First licence activation is required; activated tools continue after ordinary support expiry.

Fictional previews unlock nothing and make no Frictions request. Hide sidebar examples with Pro previews. Both editions retain safety limits.

Privacy and local storage

Replay stays in private WordPress tables: random IDs, protected page structure and appearance, visible page text and selections, local asset copies, coarse device/browser categories, events/timing and eligible order associations. The supplied recorder omits ordinary textbox values when masking is On. A modified browser client can mislabel text as visible content; the server cannot establish its origin or guarantee removal of all personal data. Data is compressed, not database-encrypted. Secure hosting, access and backups; no anonymity or compliance guarantee.

Defaults: 7 days, 256 MiB; configurable 1–365 days/16–10,240 MiB. Capture pauses at the budget; bookmarks expire. Each recording is limited to 32 MiB uncompressed, one hour active and 30 minutes idle. These limits do not measure total hosting space.

Order associations expire within the selected retention from their creation and never later than their replay. Shorter retention caps existing replay and association expiry; increasing it does not extend them. Upgrade also caps older associations. Separate short-lived replay-deletion safeguards prevent delayed uploads from restoring removed recordings.

Order accepted means WooCommerce accepted an order, not that money was collected. Order marked completed reflects WooCommerce’s completed status, not independent settlement proof. Payment confirmed reflects a WooCommerce payment-complete signal. Later eligible signals update retained, associated recordings; historical outcomes are not backfilled.

Withdrawal/opt-out stops capture and requests deletion, with retries on other site pages without recording them. Completion needs the matching WooCommerce session and a request reaching the store; offline visits, cleared storage or ended sessions cannot guarantee it. Accepted withdrawal revokes access before deletion; failures remain retryable.

Expired replays are unavailable. Cleanup and Action Scheduler order delivery need working workers. Backups/exports are not erased. WordPress privacy tools cover associated accounts/orders, including registered abandoned checkouts; anonymous unassociated visits need a replay reference.

Full privacy, browser-storage and access details: bundled privacy-and-controls.txt.

Optional external service

Setup and Settings → Communication offer separate unchecked opt-ins, independent of recording:

  • Compatibility: domain, WordPress/WooCommerce/PHP/Frictions Free versions and language, on save and at most weekly.
  • Email: chosen email for Frictions tips/releases; email-only signup omits installation/domain details. New subscriptions require confirmation. Articles/offers are separate preferences; existing preferences are preserved.

Endpoint: https://frictions.com/newsletter-api/v1/frictions-welcome/

Requests include a random connection ID, credential and consent version; the service receives times/network address. No replay, checkout, order, customer data or plugin list is sent. Viewing/skipping or choosing neither sends nothing. Check status requests an update, not delivery proof.

Stop in Communication; retry unconfirmed withdrawal. Stopping a signup created here cancels it or unsubscribes all its Frictions newsletter topics. Existing subscriptions need their own unsubscribe link; account mail is unaffected. Uninstall makes no remote request: stop first or unsubscribe by email.

Compatibility details expire after 90 days without reports. Further retention details: privacy-and-controls.txt and privacy policy. Service terms. Consent providers may contact their own services.

Related plugins from Plugins.shop

Optional tools from the same publisher:

  • Cartdini — Add checkout questions and keep answers with the order.
  • OrderFloor — Set minimum orders, quantity limits and pack rules with shopper notices.
  • Logged.ai — Review supported site/WooCommerce changes when investigating checkout problems.

Separate plugins, not requirements or automatic integrations. Check each listing’s features and requirements.

Source and builds

PHP: root and includes/. Browser scripts: assets/. TypeScript, instructions and pinned lockfile: source/. With Node 24.21.0, run npm ci --ignore-scripts then npm run build in source/ to reproduce the three bundles. No remote executable-code loader.
sections.installation:
1. Use PHP 8.1 or later and WordPress 7.0 or later. Activate WooCommerce 11.0 or later, then Frictions. Your chosen WooCommerce release may require newer WordPress or PHP versions.
  2. Review retention/storage, save a recording mode, then deliberately enable capture.
  3. Run Verify a real recording in a separate shopper browser; it does not override permission.
  4. Test refusal, withdrawal and checkout/theme/gateway/cache compatibility. Check scheduling and hosting capacity.

Samples are fictional. Administrators/non-production sites are excluded by default; development needs explicit opt-in. Network activation is unsupported.

Back up and replace files without uninstalling to preserve settings. Update Free first; separate Pro workflows require their own compatibility check. Former hosted 0.2.0 data/subscriptions need separate handling.
sections.faq:
Does PHP 8.1 compatibility mean it is recommended for a new store?

No. Compatibility requirements are separate from upstream security maintenance. Use an actively maintained PHP, WordPress and WooCommerce release supported by your host and other plugins. PHP 8.1 is end-of-life upstream; compatibility does not provide security updates or certify every theme, gateway or version combination.

Is CookieYes required?

No. The built-in prompt needs neither a banner plugin nor hosted account. Standalone CookieYes 3.5.8 needs getCkyConsent(), completed action and analytics consent; Cookiebot needs statistics consent. Older integrations need the required API or custom bridge (default denied). A banner or Google Consent Mode alone is not permission.

Does it record the whole website?

No. Capture covers the supported same-site permalink checkout, excluding order-pay, thank-you, account, other pages and off-site payments. Plain ?page_id= checkout URLs and third-party checkout builders are unsupported. The privacy-only helper does not record other pages.

Why does a recording say No order observed?

Association needs proof on that exact Classic/Blocks request, not a shared account/session. Missing proof, drafts and expired/revoked recordings are not guessed. Guest-to-login changes fail closed. Queued outcomes need Action Scheduler; this label alone does not mean checkout failed.

What happens on deactivation or uninstall?

Deactivation stops recording and jobs; unexpired data remains. Cleanup cannot run while inactive: delete beforehand if needed. Reactivation resumes cleanup and can restore previously enabled recording on the same site when its saved setup and checks still pass. Previously paused sites stay paused. Changed or incomplete setups need review before recording resumes. Free uninstall removes participating sites’ local/registered Pro data; networks above 1,000 sites need administrator handling. Pro-only uninstall keeps Free recordings. No remote deletion, billing cancellation or backup erasure occurs.
sections.changelog:
1.2.13

  • Lower the PHP requirement to 8.1 after compatibility testing. WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 11.0 minimums remain unchanged; individual WooCommerce releases retain their own requirements.
  • Preserve recording, masking, privacy choices, retention and existing data. Current screenshots retain their actual 1.2.12 capture labels.

1.2.12

  • Refresh the directory screenshots and bundled Pro examples with genuine current-version interface captures and fictional data.
  • Align screenshot captions and example descriptions with the shown workflows. Recording, privacy choices, retention and replay behavior are unchanged from 1.2.11.

1.2.11

  • Apply selected retention to order associations, reconcile older expiry and hide expired order-to-replay links.
  • Recognize later WooCommerce completion and payment-complete signals without treating cash-on-delivery processing as collected payment.
  • Validate stored event payloads, private verification state and optional theme font data before use.
  • Clarify textbox masking’s client-side trust boundary while retaining visible text, selections and protected payment regions.

1.2.10

  • Open replays at the top of the workspace so the heading and playback controls are visible, including when choosing Next replay.
  • Keep Back to list returning to the previous list position and make unavailable-replay messages visible.

1.2.9

  • Preserve appropriate recording state on same-site reactivation and avoid unnecessary pauses when recording setup is unchanged.
  • Clearly explain unavailable replays and retain existing recordings, masking choices and playback preferences.
  • Improve replay loading and fullscreen feedback; remove unsupported security-policy warnings without relaxing replay isolation.

1.2.8

  • Refresh the bundled Pro examples and directory screenshots with genuine captures and matching version-labelled captions.
  • Clarify which review tools are included in Free and which require the separate Pro add-on.
  • Keep capture, masking, saved settings and replay playback unchanged from 1.2.7.

1.2.7

  • Add replay-reference search, explicit sorting, quick date ranges and removable active-filter chips.
  • Add page selection and bulk watched/bookmark actions with atomic expiry and revocation checks.
  • Show retained shopper receipt time and explain incomplete recordings without assuming checkout abandonment or payment failure.
  • Keep recording, privacy, masking and browser playback choices unchanged.

1.2.6

  • Enable Skip inactivity by default and remember explicit On or Off choices in this browser for each site and administrator account.
  • Preserve full-screen activation setup, saved recording choices and the paint-safe replay player.

1.2.5

  • Fix white flashing during replay frame changes without relaxing the replay sandbox.
  • Place Evidence, Team notes and Developer brief below the player, with a taller checkout viewing area.
  • Preserve saved recording and masking choices and existing recordings.

1.2.4

  • Wait for replay data and the checkout frame before starting or resuming the playback clock.
  • Move the replay cursor without repeatedly reloading the page, and keep the current frame visible while the next frame loads.
  • Fix Team notes preview tabs overlapping the replay controls on desktop.
  • Preserve saved recording and masking choices, existing recordings and replay isolation.

1.2.3

  • Batch ordinary checkout activity every 15 seconds to reduce repeated upload requests.
  • Pace queued uploads after temporary host throttling instead of sending a rapid catch-up burst. Respect Retry-After and preserve bounded retries.
  • Keep saved recording modes, masking choices, privacy-link settings and existing recordings unchanged.

1.2.2

  • Recover from temporary recording-start failures with bounded retries and request timeouts instead of locking the tab out.
  • Refresh recording lists when returning to the page and provide an explicit refresh action.
  • Simplify first setup and add default-On text-field masking controls. Payment and security fields remain protected when masking is Off.

1.2.1

  • Remove the synthetic setup demonstration. Review your recording mode, then verify a real logged-out shopper visit.
  • Retry temporary upload throttling without discarding the rejected batch. Respect Retry-After and retain bounded memory-only buffering.
  • Keep permanent storage limits, privacy controls and administrator exclusions in place. Older recordings remain structural.

1.2.0

  • New recordings preserve supported checkout-page appearance with approved public text and local image/font copies.
  • Keep customer values and payment regions masked, and replay isolated from scripts and external requests.
  • Preserve older structural recordings and explicitly label visual fallbacks.
  • Retain default-Off privacy-link choices and existing recording/withdrawal controls.

1.1.8

  • Replace floating privacy controls with an inline link and expandable choices.
  • Add an automatic-link visibility setting and manual-placement shortcode.
  • Preserve permission, refusal, withdrawal and the 1.1.7 security protections.

Full release history: bundled changelog.txt.
